tasks.label: Push SCL to TIA Portal
args: $device = '${input:deviceName}'; $block = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension('${file}'); $src = Get-Content '${file}' -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $body = [System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer]::Serialize(@{ source = $src }); $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/devices/$device/blocks/$block/scl" -Method PUT -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'; Write-Host ($r | ConvertTo-Json)

tasks.label: Create Block in TIA Portal
args: $device = '${input:deviceName}'; $block = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension('${file}'); $type = '${input:blockType}'; $src = Get-Content '${file}' -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $body = [System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer]::Serialize(@{ name = $block; type = $type; language = 'SCL'; number = $null; sourceCode = $src }); $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/devices/$device/blocks" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'; Write-Host ($r | ConvertTo-Json)

inputs.description: Block type: FB, FC, OB, or GlobalDB
